posts.title: Check fan speed if your Mac mini UI becomes super slow
posts.description: For several days, I was struggling with a strange issue on my Mac mini M2 Pro: soon after restart, like 5mins or so, entire system would becomes super slow. UI would visibly render bit by bit, switching between windows would be very slow etc. I could literally count how system Settings app is drawing its many rows.
